result:
My verdict on the Figma round-trip is **fix**: all four checkable asks are met, but the shots don't show the new token table's colour swatches, and the desktop widths never show the table at all. The fifth ask, the report on the card, I couldn't check because the card wasn't in what I was given. The full review is in [report.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/figma-to-code/review/report.md).

### ⚠️ Two fixes `ext/Figma/tokens/`
- **Swatches and summary missing:** on the [tokens page](/framework/ext/Figma/tokens/) at 400px, the `prime` row shows no colour swatch even though both sides have a colour value. The table also shows open, with no "All 24 variables" summary above it. Either the shots were taken before the fix went in, or that code doesn't render. A new set of shots would show which.
- **Desktop shots miss the new section:** the 1200, 1920 and 3440 shots are scrolled to the bottom of the page, so the table is only seen at 400.

---

### ✅ What is met
- **Inventory:** the script counts 36 Figma pages and 36 inventory rows, so the two counts agree; 6 have code.
- **Token map:** 24 variables. 5 match the site by name and value, 9 match by role under another name, and 6 exist only in Figma.
- **Decision note and coordination:** the task log shows the decision note was posted, the Figma agent got the map link and the next ask, and both Figma agents' replies are recorded.

The notes are minor: the 400px table runs nearly two screens  …
